recipe.purpose: Nine-max behaviour captured on origin/main BEFORE the 6-max slice touched any code, so the parity test compares the new code to the old, never to itself.
steps: positions[b] = positions_for_button(b) for b in range(9).
rotation = button seats from rotation_start, stepping (b + 1) % 9.

hands[i]: lineup = assign_lineup(random.Random(seed)); state = start_hand(deal_hand(random.Random(seed)), button_seat=seed % 9, stacks_bb=[stack_bb] * 9); bots advance with random.Random(seed ^ 0xABCDEF ^ hero_decision_index) (the pre-hero advance uses index 0, i.e. seed ^ 0xABCDEF); the hero takes the legal action at index % len(legal_actions(state)), sized at min_bb; grades come from app.domain.providers.get_provider().evaluate(spot, decision) over map_decision_point(state, 0).
recipe.deliberately_absent: _sim_signature is NOT captured: owner decision D1 changes it for 9-max too (sim:rfi:LJ becomes sim:9:rfi:LJ), so pinning it here would contradict the spec.
